Runtime call-site audit:
Searched the complete internal/native/runtime tree at 9534e8ab and library's codex/regex-replace-callback 132d9919, using git grep for (->|.)code followed by a call and for adamic_method. Additional searches examined code-field references and method-table access.
At 9534e8ab the only runtime closure call is array.c:198. At 132d9919 there are six:
1. array.c:198: compare->code(compare, (adamic_value[]){left, right}). Type: adamic_code, two arguments, no cast. Sort comparator receives two JavaScript arguments.
2. node_process.c:436: closure->code(closure, padded). Type: adamic_code, two arguments, no cast. Built-in performance closures receive padded string slots. Logical count is available in the enclosing invoke function but padding length is not that count.
3. node_process.c:441: closure->code(closure, args). Type: adamic_code, two arguments, no cast. User-closure fallback in performance invocation; enclosing count must remain the actual count if the candidate closure observes it.
4. parallel.c:197: scope->work->code(scope->work, arguments). Type: adamic_code, two arguments, no cast. Worker callback receives element and index.
5. parallel.c:300: work->code(work, arguments). Type: adamic_code, two arguments, no cast. Sequential worker callback receives element and index.
6. regexp_replace.c:114: callback->code(callback, packed). Type: adamic_code, two arguments, no cast. The local argument_count is the JavaScript match callback count; packed_count is a parameter/rest layout size and must not replace it.
The library header defines adamic_code once at adamic.h:126 as adamic_value (*)(adamic_closure *, adamic_value *).
The checkpoint header defines the same shape once at adamic.h:81.

Method audit:
No runtime C site invokes an adamic_method pointer in either audited tree.
At 9534e8ab, adamic.h:196 defines adamic_method once as adamic_value (*)(adamic_object *, adamic_value *); adamic_methods.code at :200 is a const adamic_method pointer; object.c:57 adamic_object_callee returns a method through its typed output parameter. Invocation is emitted by internal/native/emit_functions.go, callThrough.
At 132d9919, corresponding locations are adamic.h:248 (typedef), :252 (table) and object.c:66 (lookup).
class_inheritance.c:19 accesses a separate class-method function-index table, not an adamic_method invocation.
The unfinished census merge changed adamic_code and adamic_method to universal three-argument pointers and array.c:198 to three arguments. Those changes were not validated and are not in this checkpoint.

Mutants:
No new drop-count compiler mutant has been run for this unit. Historical arguments-length mutants are documented in arguments-length-revision-report.txt; those do not prove the new C-arity requirement.

Unfinished scope:
The merges of 24a2b287 and cd220dd5, the single typed selective-count convention, runtime/library integration, host fixture 24, and the compiler-rejected drop-count mutant remain unfinished.
The attempted 24a2b287 merge had overlapping lowering/emission changes and universal ABI changes outside conflict blocks. Resolving textual conflicts alone did not yield a coherent implementation, so the unvalidated merge was saved and aborted.
Full unfinished patch: /tmp/closure-convention-unfinished-census-merge.patch. Merge head: /tmp/closure-convention-unfinished-merge-head.txt. These are local recovery artifacts, not pushed commits.

Scratch merge 87ba1951 was unavailable from the fetched refs; no claim is made that its host validation was reproduced here.
